rules.title: Installers you already used
rules.explanation: Disk images and installer packages in Downloads. Once an app is installed, these setup files aren't needed.

rules.title: Downloads you haven't opened in a year
rules.explanation: Anything in Downloads that hasn't changed in a year. Look through these before you remove them.

rules.title: Mail attachments you opened
rules.explanation: Copies Mail makes when you open an attachment. The original stays in the email, so you can open it again.
